ModifyApiGroup.description_en: Modifies the name, description, or base path of an existing API group
ModifyApiGroup.description_zh: 修改已经存在的API分组的名称，描述，或者basepath

ModifyApiGroupInstance.description_en: Changes the instance of an API group

ModifyApiGroupNetworkPolicy.description_en: Modifies the network policy of an API group

ModifyApiGroupVpcWhitelist.description_en: Modifies the VPC whitelist of an API group
ModifyApiGroupVpcWhitelist.description_zh: 修改API分组VPC专有网络白名单

ModifyBackend.description_en: You cannot modify the basic information of a backend service—such as its name, description, or backend service type—after the backend service is created
ModifyBackend.description_zh: 修改后端服务的基本信息如名称，描述，后端服务类型一经创建无法修改

ModifyBackendModel.description_en: This operation modifies the definition of a backend service in an environment. After the modification, the backend addresses of APIs that use this backend service and are published in this environment are batch updated automatically, without requiring manual publishing
ModifyBackendModel.description_zh: 修改后端服务在环境上的定义，修改后，使用该后端服务并发布在此环境上的API的后端地址都会批量更新，无需手动发布

ModifyDataset.description_en: Updates the name of a custom dataset
ModifyDataset.description_zh: 修改用户自定义数据集名称

ModifyDatasetItem.description_en: Modifies the timeout period and description of a data entry in a custom dataset
ModifyDatasetItem.description_zh: 修改用户自定义数据集的数据条目的超时时间和描述

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies the properties of an API Gateway instance

ModifyInstanceSpec.description_en: Upgrades or downgrades the configurations of an API Gateway instance
ModifyInstanceSpec.description_zh: API网关实例升降配置变更接口

ModifyInstanceVpcAttributeForConsole.description_zh: 修改实例的客户端所在VPC

ModifyIntranetDomainPolicy.description_en: Modifies the VPC domain name policy of an API group
ModifyIntranetDomainPolicy.description_zh: 修改分组的内网VPC域名策略

ModifyIpControl.description_zh: 修改某个已存在的IP访问控制

ModifyIpControlPolicyItem.description_en: Modifies a policy in an access control list (ACL)
ModifyIpControlPolicyItem.description_zh: 修改某个IP访问控制下的某条策略

ModifyModel.description_en: Updates the model of an API group

ModifyPlugin.description_en: Modifies the information of a plug-in

ModifySignature.description_zh: 修改API网关后端签名密钥

ModifyTrafficControl.description_en: Modifies the settings of a custom throttling policy
ModifyTrafficControl.description_zh: 修改用户自定义的流控策略设置

ModifyVpcAccessAndUpdateApis.description_en: Modifies the information of a VPC access authorization and updates the metadata of the associated API
ModifyVpcAccessAndUpdateApis.description_zh: 修改VPC授权信息并更新关联的API元信息

QueryRequestLogs.description_en: Queries the request logs of a user
QueryRequestLogs.description_zh: 查询用户的操作日志记录

ReactivateDomain.description_en: Reactivates a custom domain name whose validity status is Abnormal
ReactivateDomain.description_zh: 重新激活合法状态为异常的自定义域名

RemoveAccessControlListEntry.description_en: This operation removes IP address entries from the access control policy of a dedicated API Gateway instance
RemoveAccessControlListEntry.description_zh:
本功能为API网关专享实例提供实例级别的访问控制能力；
在实例的访问控制策略中删除IP条目

RemoveApiProductsAuthorities.description_en: Revokes permissions on API products from an application
RemoveApiProductsAuthorities.description_zh: 批量移除API产品对指定APP的授权

RemoveApisAuthorities.description_en: Revokes the access permissions of a specified application to multiple APIs
RemoveApisAuthorities.description_zh: 撤销指定应用（app）对多个API的访问权限

RemoveAppsAuthorities.description_en: Revokes the access permissions on a specified API from multiple apps. In this case, multiple apps map to a single API
RemoveAppsAuthorities.description_zh: 撤销多个APP对指定API的访问权限，多个APP一个API

RemoveIpControlApis.description_en: Unbinds an API from an access control list (ACL)
RemoveIpControlApis.description_zh: 解除API与IP访问控制的绑定关系

RemoveIpControlPolicyItem.description_en: Removes one or more policies from an access control list (ACL)
RemoveIpControlPolicyItem.description_zh: 移除某个IP访问控制下的一条或多条策略

RemoveSignatureApis.description_en: Unbinds a backend signature key from APIs
RemoveSignatureApis.description_zh: 解除API与后端签名密钥的绑定关系

RemoveTrafficControlApis.description_en: Unbinds a specified throttling policy from APIs
RemoveTrafficControlApis.description_zh: 解除API与流控策略的绑定关系

RemoveVpcAccess.description_en: Deletes a VPC access authorization without unpublishing the associated APIs
RemoveVpcAccess.description_zh: 仅删除VPC授权，不做下线关联API的修改

RemoveVpcAccessAndAbolishApis.description_en: Removes a VPC authorization and unpublishes the associated APIs
RemoveVpcAccessAndAbolishApis.description_zh: 删除VPC授权并下线关联的已经发布在线上的API

ResetAppCode.description_en: Resets the AppCode of an application. This operation can be called only once per minute for each user
ResetAppCode.description_zh: 重置应用的AppCode。此接口每个用户每分钟只能调一次

ResetAppSecret.description_en: Resets the key for an app

SdkGenerateByApp.description_en: Generates a software development kit (SDK) for an application

SdkGenerateByAppForRegion.description_en: Generates an SDK for APIs associated with an app

SdkGenerateByGroup.description_en: Generate an SDK by API group

SetAccessControlListAttribute.description_en: This feature provides instance-level access control for API Gateway exclusive instances and lets you modify the access control policy name
SetAccessControlListAttribute.description_zh:
本功能为API网关专享实例提供实例级别的访问控制能力；
修改访问控制策略名称

SetApiProductsAuthorities.description_en: Grants batch authorization of API products to a specified application

SetApisAuthorities.description_en: Authorizes a specified application to call multiple APIs
SetApisAuthorities.description_zh: 给指定app添加多个API的访问权限

SetAppsAuthToApiProduct.description_en: Authorizes multiple applications to call APIs in an API product
SetAppsAuthToApiProduct.description_zh: 批量授权多个APP给指定的API产品

SetAppsAuthorities.description_en: Grants access permissions on a specified API to multiple applications
SetAppsAuthorities.description_zh: 给多个 APP 添加指定 API 的访问权限

SetDomain.description_en: Binds a custom domain name to a specified API group
SetDomain.description_zh: 给指定API分组绑定自定义域名

SetDomainCertificate.description_en: Uploads an SSL certificate for a specified custom domain name
SetDomainCertificate.description_zh: 为指定自定义域名上传SSL证书

SetDomainWebSocketStatus.description_en: Enables or disables WebSocket for a custom domain name
SetDomainWebSocketStatus.description_zh: 开通或关闭自定义域名的WebSocket

SetIpControlApis.description_en: Creates a binding relationship between specified access control lists (ACLs) and APIs
SetIpControlApis.description_zh: 添加指定IP访问控制与API的绑定关系

SetSignatureApis.description_en: Binds a signature key to APIs
SetSignatureApis.description_zh: 添加指定签名密钥与API的绑定

SetTrafficControlApis.description_en: Binds a throttling policy to APIs
SetTrafficControlApis.description_zh: 添加指定流控策略与API的绑定

SetVpcAccess.description_en: Creates a VPC authorization and enables reverse access. You can use this operation to create a VPC authorization
SetVpcAccess.description_zh: 创建VPC授权，开通反向访问

SetWildcardDomainPatterns.description_en: Specifies a wildcard domain name template for a bound custom domain name
SetWildcardDomainPatterns.description_zh: 为绑定的自定义域名设置泛域名模板

SwitchApi.description_en: Switches the definition of an API in a specified runtime environment to a historical version
SwitchApi.description_zh: 指定历史版本切换掉指定环境中正在运行中的API定义，即用历史定义替换运行中定义

TagResources.description_zh: 创建标签资源关系（用户标签）

UntagResources.description_zh: 删除用户标签和资源的关系

UpdatePrivateDNS.description_en: Modifies an internal domain name resolution

ValidateVpcConnectivity.description_en: Tests the network connectivity from API Gateway to a specified port of a specified instance in a specified VPC authorization
ValidateVpcConnectivity.description_zh: 测试API网关到指定VPC授权中指定实例的指定端口的网络连通性
